title: Qingce Village Treasure Hunt
description: At your suggestion, the two of you decide to seek the treasure in Qingce Village. What will you encounter on the way?

mainQuestExcel.title: Qingce Village Treasure Hunt
mainQuestExcel.description: At your suggestion, the two of you decide to seek the treasure in Qingce Village. What will you encounter on the way?

flow.stepDescription: Go to Ren for a little conversation
Take part in the village banquet
Go to the waterwheel where the chest is

dialogs.text: It's not often this village gets so lively. Make yourself at home, Traveler, help yourself to some food and drink.
It's not just me saying this, honestly — those finches are the cutest little things! So plump and fluffy... Traveler, do you want to swing by my place and see them?
Ji may not be the sharpest tool in the shed, but even I can't deny he's just a big softie at heart.
Why isn't Pops Xing here tonight?
Changping, come on, let me top you off!
Thanks, but no thanks... I'm getting a little light-headed...
The crystal-clear fluid that fills this cup is a fruit juice that Beidou specially ordered for you.
